title: First visit or cleared storage yields all defaults; no server-side profile
refs: SV-8640 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 23 S23-R4; S23-N1; Story 2 S2-R4; S2-R7; Story 21 S21-R2)
preconds:
1. You have distinctive saved settings, then clear the browser's site data (or use a fresh profile).
2. You are working in a known active location (the application's location switcher).
steps: 1. Open the report and read every setting.
expected:
1. Date range = This Month; Product Type = "Parts & Service"; Invoice Status = "All Statuses"; Location = your currently active location only (the one location you are working in); Show Unassigned = off; all eight metric columns visible; sort = the A→Z default.
2. Clearing browser storage fully returns the report to first-visit defaults — no server-side profile brings the old settings back.

---
